extension_name.description: Display name placeholder; the final name must not contain YouTube or YT.

extension_description.message: Playback and interface controls for YouTube in Safari.

n_speedDefault.message: Applied to every video. 1 is normal.

s_speedOverride.message: Start every video at the custom default speed

n_speedOverride.message: Off: the speed you last used carries over to the next video.

n_speedStep.message: Change per scroll notch or button press.

n_speedWheel.message: Hold Option (⌥) and scroll over the video.

n_volumeWheel.message: Scroll over the video without a modifier key.

s_qualityRevert.message: Switch back when leaving full screen

n_codecStandardFps.message: 24, 25 or 30 fps instead of 48, 50 or 60. Easier on the battery.

n_codecAvc.message: Instead of VP9 or AV1. Hardware decoding everywhere; caps quality at 1080p.

n_autoplayOff.message: Keeps the Up next switch off.

s_autoplayBlockBackground.message: Don’t start videos in background tabs

s_pauseOtherTabs.message: Pause other tabs when a video starts

n_miniPlayer.message: Keeps the video in a corner when you scroll past it.

n_controlsPlacement.message: Inside the video controls, in a bar under the video, or both.

n_controls.message: Every other action stays one tap away in the ••• menu.

n_debug.message: Prints what the extension does to the Web Inspector console on YouTube pages.

n_hideEndScreens.message: The channel and video cards over the last seconds.

s_hideEndWall.message: Hide suggestions when a video ends

n_hideEndWall.message: The grid of videos that covers the player at the end.

n_autoplayBlockBackground.message: Shows the thumbnail and a play button instead; nothing downloads until you press play.

n_autoplayBlockForeground.message: Blocks fresh loads only; a video you open while another is playing still starts.

n_miniSize.message: Custom takes a width in pixels; the height follows 16:9.

n_volumeDefaultOn.message: Sets YouTube's volume slider when a video loads. Mac only.

n_qualityAuto.message: Picks the nearest available level when the exact one is missing.

n_qualityPlaylist.message: For videos opened from a playlist or mix.

n_qualityFullscreen.message: Switches when you enter full screen.

n_qualityFsVideo.message: For single videos in full screen.

n_qualityFsPlaylist.message: For playlist videos in full screen.

n_qualityRevert.message: Otherwise the full-screen quality stays after you exit.

n_autoplayAllowPlaylists.message: Playlists and mixes keep playing on their own.

n_pauseOtherTabs.message: Only one YouTube tab plays at a time.

n_cinemaDim.message: How dark the page around the player gets.

n_theme.message: Match device follows your Mac or iPhone appearance. Black is pure black for OLED screens.

n_accent.message: Used by the Dark with accent theme.

n_hideRelated.message: The column of suggested videos next to the player.

n_hideChat.message: Live chat and chat replay next to streams.

n_hideShorts.message: Shorts shelves, the Shorts tab and Shorts in results.

n_hideCards.message: The info-card teaser in the top-right of the player.

n_hideMoreVideos.message: The row of suggestions over a paused video.

n_hideNotifications.message: The bell in the top bar.

n_shortsAsVideos.message: Shorts open in the normal player with comments and speed control.

n_audioMode.message: Lowest quality with the picture hidden behind the thumbnail; about 95% less data. The toolbar button toggles it per video.

n_autoDescription.message: Opens the full description on every video.

n_autoTranscript.message: Shows the transcript panel when a video has one.

n_autoAsk.message: Opens YouTube's Ask panel when it is offered.

s_emailCopy.message: Copy button next to email addresses

n_emailCopy.message: Adds Copy after any email in the description.

s_linksNewTab.message: Open links and @mentions in a new tab

n_linksNewTab.message: Links in the title and description, and channel mentions. Timestamps still seek.

n_guestMode.message: Turning this on saves your youtube.com cookies inside the extension and signs YouTube out, so it sees a first-time visitor; turning it off puts them back. If YouTube signs you in again by itself or anything breaks, turn it off and reload. Reloads YouTube tabs.

n_hideHomeFeed.message: An empty home page; search and subscriptions still work.

n_hideViews.message: On video lists and the watch page.

n_hideChips.message: The row of filters above the home feed and related videos.

n_hideGuide.message: The whole left navigation and its menu button.

n_hideNavExplore.message: Music, Gaming, Trending and the rest of that section.

n_hideNavYou.message: The You entry and its section.

n_hideNavMore.message: Premium, Music, Kids and Labs links.

n_hideVoiceSearch.message: The microphone next to the search box.

n_shortcuts.message: Click a key, then press a combination with Option, Control or Shift so YouTube's own keys keep working. Backspace clears, Esc cancels.

n_backup.message: Export writes a JSON file of every setting; Import reads one back; Reset restores the defaults.

n_welcome.message: The setup page shown after installing.

w_intro.message: Pick a starting point. Everything can be changed later.

w_focused_note.message: No Shorts, topic chips, bell, or suggestion grids.

w_fast_note.message: Every video at 1.5×, bigger steps, speed buttons in the toolbar.

w_clean_note.message: Focused, plus titles instead of thumbnails and a trimmed sidebar.

w_devices.message: Also on iPhone and iPad. Settings move with Export and Import.

n_customCssOn.message: Add your own styles to every YouTube page.

h_title.message: Playback and interface controls for YouTube

h_intro.message: Speed, quality, autoplay, a cleaner page and a small toolbar in the player. Everything is on YouTube itself; this page only sets preferences.

h_feedback.message: Something missing or broken? Tell me on the Support page.

h_allset.message: All set. Your choices are saved; browse the sections on the left any time.

h_allset_short.message: All set. Your choices are saved; browse the sections any time.

sp_intro.message: Questions, bugs and ideas are welcome. Say which device and Safari version you use and what you expected to happen.

support_email.description: Support contact shown on the Support page; change before release.

w_recommended_note.message: Auto 1080p, no autoplay in background tabs, mini player, and no Shorts, chips, bell or suggestion grids.

n_captionsAuto.message: Switches captions on when a video has them.

n_captionsLang.message: Picks the video’s captions in this language, or asks YouTube to translate when it has none. Auto keeps YouTube’s choice.

n_timeRemaining.message: Adds the remaining time next to the duration, at the current speed.

s_pauseOnBlur.message: Pause when you leave the window

n_pauseOnBlur.message: Pauses when Safari loses focus and resumes when it comes back.

n_resumePositions.message: Remembers the position of the last 300 videos on this device, also when signed out.

n_autoTheater.message: Switches to the wide player on every video. If the layout sticks, reload the page.

n_screenshotTo.message: A PNG in Downloads, or straight to the clipboard.

s_homeRedirect.message: Open instead of the home page

n_homeRedirect.message: Where the YouTube logo and the home page take you.

n_hideWatched.message: Videos with a red progress bar disappear from feeds and related lists.

n_hideLive.message: Live, upcoming and premiere items disappear from feeds.

n_blockedChannels.message: One per line: a channel name or @handle. Their videos disappear from feeds, search and related lists.

n_blockedKeywords.message: One per line. Videos whose title contains a word disappear.

n_sbEnabled.message: Uses the SponsorBlock community database (sponsor.ajay.app). Only a short hash of each video ID is sent, never the full ID or your account. Asks once for access to that server.

n_sb_sponsor.message: Paid promotions and ads read by the creator.

n_sb_preview.message: Clips of what is coming or what happened.

n_sb_filler.message: Tangents and jokes. Aggressive, off by default.

n_sbNotify.message: A brief pill on the video.

n_hidePromoted.message: Sponsored items in feeds, the masthead banner and shopping shelves. Video ads are not affected.

n_adSkip.message: Mutes and fast-forwards ads in the player and presses Skip as soon as it appears. This goes against YouTube's terms; YouTube may change the player at any time. Sponsored Shorts are skipped too.

n_rydEnabled.message: Uses the Return YouTube Dislike service (returnyoutubedislikeapi.com). Sends the video ID. Asks once for access to that server.

n_dearrowTitles.message: Replaces clickbait titles on the watch page with community-written ones from DeArrow (sponsor.ajay.app). Same privacy as sponsor skipping.

n_backgroundPlay.message: Keeps audio going when you switch apps or lock the screen on iPhone and iPad. Reload the page after changing.

n_sbWhitelist.message: One channel name per line. Segments are still marked.

n_hidePlayables.message: The games shelf and its sidebar entry.

n_hideAi.message: The Ask button and panel on the watch page.

s_gridColumns.message: Videos per row on the home page

n_gridColumns.message: Auto lets YouTube decide from the window width.

n_noTranslate.message: Undoes YouTube's automatic title translation on the watch page.

n_hideMixes.message: The auto-generated playlists in feeds and related lists.

n_stripTracking.message: Drops si, pp and feature parameters from the URL so copied links carry nothing extra.

n_seekStep.message: For the Seek back and Seek forward buttons and shortcuts.

n_controlsAlwaysVisible.message: The progress bar and buttons never fade out.

n_hideOverlays.message: The channel watermark and the most-replayed heat map.

n_hideAmbient.message: YouTube’s Ambient mode, the coloured glow around the player in the dark theme.

n_hideShorterThan.message: Judged from the duration badge on the thumbnail.

n_hideLongerThan.message: Live streams without a duration are not affected.

n_fixCaps.message: Titles written mostly in capitals are shown in sentence case.

n_fullTitles.message: No more cut-off titles with an ellipsis.

n_thumbFrames.message: Shows a frame from the video instead of the uploaded cover image. Cuts clickbait; costs a little data.

s_hidePosts.message: Hide Community posts and membership shelves

n_hidePosts.message: In feeds and on channel pages.

n_hideSearchShelves.message: Removes the “People also watched”, “For you” and similar shelves between results.

n_adAllowChannels.message: One channel name per line. Ads play normally there.

n_rydBar.message: A thin ratio bar under the buttons.

n_dismissContinue.message: Answers YouTube's idle prompt for you.

s_hideActionButtons.message: Hide Share, Clip, Thanks and Save

n_hideActionButtons.message: Leaves like, dislike and the menu under the video.

n_blockedCommentWords.message: One per line. Comments containing a word are hidden.

n_shortsAutoNext.message: No looping; the next Short starts when one ends. Waits while a comments or description panel is open, unless comments open automatically.

n_grayscale.message: Removes colour from the whole site; a focus aid.

badge_beta.description: Badge on settings that are built but not yet verified on YouTube in Safari

h_resumed.description: HUD pill shown before the time when a video resumes where you left off

d_label.description: Label of the per-section defaults row

d_note.message: YouTube’s defaults turns everything in this section off, so YouTube behaves as it does on its own. Recommended applies our suggested values for this section.
d_note.description: Note under the per-section defaults row

d_youtube.description: Button: reset the section to YouTube’s own behaviour

d_recommended.description: Button: apply the recommended values for the section

o_light.description: Theme option: force YouTube’s light theme

o_learn.description: Link under a setting to the service’s website

p_explain.message: Safari will now ask for access to $HOST$. Choose “Always Allow” so this keeps working after restarts. Nothing else is shared with that server.
p_explain.description: Shown before the optional host permission prompt

p_continue.description: Button that opens the Safari permission prompt

p_cancel.description: Button that dismisses the permission explanation

t_saved_reload.description: Toast for settings that need a page reload

t_reload.description: Toast button that reloads YouTube tabs

b_copy.description: Copies the settings JSON to the clipboard

n_shortsComments.message: Shows the comments panel as soon as a Short starts; it stays open while you scroll.

n_shortsCaptions.message: Turns captions on for every Short, in the caption language set under Playback.

n_shortsSpeed.message: Same as videos follows the Playback settings.

s_menuSide.description: Toolbar setting: where the ••• menu and panels open when the toolbar sits under the video

n_menuSide.message: Automatic opens upward over the video when there is no room below.

n_feedPreviews.message: The short clips that play when you hover a video or a Short in a feed. With sound needs one click on the page first, as Safari requires.

n_previewCaptionsOff.message: Turning captions on for previews is YouTube’s own setting under Playback and performance.

k_hint.description: Prefix before the assigned shortcuts on a related setting

k_hint_none.message: No shortcuts set yet; see Shortcuts.
k_hint_none.description: Shown when none of the related shortcuts is assigned

n_toolbarLabels.message: Button names next to the icons in the bar under the video. Off shows icons only.

s_tabFullscreen.message: Full screen stays in the tab

n_tabFullscreen.message: Fills the browser tab instead of opening Safari’s full-screen window. The full-screen button, f and Escape toggle it.

n_controlsBelow.message: Used by the bar under the video when the placement is Both.
